newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi,two others to develop 1-gigabit chip - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi,two others to develop 1-gigabit chip - paper.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd, Mitsubishi Electric Corp and Texas Instruments Inc have agreed to jointly develop and produce one-gigabit dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips, a Japanese business daily reported on Tuesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the three firms would equally share the expected development cost of about 100 billion yen as well as patents.
They hope to commercialise the memory chips in 1999, the paper said.
Spokesmen for the firms were not immediately available to comment on the report.
The firms had been independently developing one-gigabit DRAM chips, but decided to join hands to curb rising development costs, the paper said.
Hitachi and Texas Instruments have been jointly developing 16-, 64- and 256-megabit DRAM chips since 1988, it said.
